or.title: ଗୋଟିଏ ଶବଦରେ
stanzas: ଜୀବନର ରଙ୍ଗ ମଞ୍ଚ ରେ ନାଚି ନାଚି ଥକିପଡିପଡି

en.label: English
en.title: In a Single Word
stanzas: In the exuberant garden of an uncomprehending heart,
if only I could write a poem for you
a gathering of a thousand flowers.
Dancing and dancing on life’s stage, weary and worn,
if only through a gesture I could make you understand,
the meanings of flowers as they bloom,
all the futility that has blossomed and fallen.
Words are so far from thoughts,
only an answer to finding you.
Life is the petals of two flowers,
a gathering of you and me.

hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: एक शब्द में
stanzas: नासमझ मन के प्रगल्भ उद्यान में,
काश तुम्हारे लिए एक कविता लिख पाता,
जीवन के रंगमंच पर नाचते-नाचते, थकते-थकते,
शब्द भावनाओं से बहुत दूर हैं,
जीवन दो फूलों की पंखुड़ियाँ है,
तुम और मैं के समुच्चय में।
